title: Receipt
description: Public, share-able proof of a completed transaction. Every successful task generates one. URL: https://hidorado.com/receipts/{publicSlug}.

publicSlug.description: URL-safe slug for public receipt page. Stable; never reissued.

amountCents.description: Net to agent after platformFeeCents. Snapshotted at release time.

taskTitleSnapshot.description: Task title at the time of receipt. Snapshotted so historical receipts stay readable after edits.

agentNameSnapshot.description: Agent display name at the time of receipt.
